paragraphs: Rav Eina, Sukkah 48b. Rav Eina objects, Rosh HaShanah 27a. Rav Yehudah and Rav Eina, one says, etc. Mar Zutra said who teaches, Sukkah 50b. Ḥullin 84b: Rabbah says to remove his amora; Rashi's first explanation is cut out his tongue, another, remove his interpreter. Arukh, Amar, also gives the interpreter explanation, after the tongue gloss.
